layercake_locked_scope.claim_boundary: These locked Phase 2 measurements remain valid. V79 shows that they do not establish broad natural-English functional quality on the separate 28-prompt ABI screen.

attribution_correction.reason: The exact native host and installation path execute correctly, but the native payload itself fails the same expanded quality screen. A passing locked-scope native control cannot localize an expanded-scope quality miss to ABI alone.

comparative_context.interpretation: None passes. Candidate improvements over native do not prove transfer, and native failure prevents ABI-only attribution of the remaining quality gap.

next_required_control.name: same_topology_direct_target_oracle
next_required_control.objective: Train or otherwise construct one exact-topology LayerCake payload directly from independently qualified target behavior, without requiring ABI minimization, and evaluate it on the unchanged 28-prompt screen.
next_required_control.if_pass: The expanded host capacity is established and later ABI candidate quality failures can be localized to ABI acquisition or integration.
next_required_control.if_fail: The exact host topology has not demonstrated the expanded English target; improve or re-scope LayerCake before spending more ABI extraction compute.
